Q: How to save output of darknet YOLOv4 video in a txt file for each frame? A:

There's already an explanation on how to use the command line, especially to save result in .txt format, the link:

https://github.com/AlexeyAB/darknet#how-to-use-on-the-command-line

To save time, I will provide the part which might be helpful:

  • To process a list of images data/train.txt and save results of detection to result.txt use:
darknet.exe detector test cfg/coco.data cfg/yolov4.cfg yolov4.weights -dont_show -ext_output < data/train.txt > result.txt

Might be late but maybe helpful to the others.

Q: 'Field required a bean of type that could not be found.' error Spring RESTful API using MongoDB A:

I had the same issue. It turned out that there is another class with the same name in another module. I renamed that class, and it solved the issue.

Q: why does 2 terminal show different php version? A:

You can check you PATH environment variable by typing $env:PATH in powershell or echo %PATH% in cmd.exe. When you write "php", windows is searching for its binary in directories from PATH.

So maybe adding only path for version you need for working can solve your problem in the laragon terminal.

As I know, you can select interpreter you need in vscode directly by pressing CTRL+SHIFT+P and typing "select interpreter".
